others.name: Uplift Champion Ninetysix limited
others.role: Shareholder owned by Mr. Ching Hei Chan

what: It provides temperature-controlled logistics and warehousing services to customers in Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects about $21.6 million after costs. About 40% is for buying or investing in logistics and warehouse firms, 30% for more handling capacity and 20% for warehouse technology. The rest is for running costs and working capital.
risks: US rules on auditors that US regulators cannot inspect could be applied more strictly to companies like this one.
Cash and assets held in Hong Kong may not be freely moved out of Hong Kong.
Court judgments that shareholders win against the company may not be enforceable.
Its managers have no experience running a US public company or following the laws that apply to one.
It is a holding company and can pay dividends only if its Hong Kong subsidiary earns money and sends it up.
